Rivers South-East Senatorial candidate of the African Democratic Congress in the 2027 general elections, Bertram Ikuru, has said the party will secure a landslide victory across the state come 2027 general elections. Ikuru stated this during the inauguration of the ADC campaign council in Andoni Local Government Area of Rivers on Tuesday. Ikuru while speaking to newsmen said the council chaired by Mr Gogo Wellington would galvanise grassroots support for the ADC winning all elective seats in Andoni LGA. While congratulating members of the council, Ikuru urged them to optimise grassroots mobilisation, foster unity and advance the political objectives of the party. He stated, “I am optimistic that this team would deliver a very impactful campaign, it would maximally mobilise voters across the 11 wards of Andoni to secure a total victory for our dear party. 2027: Akiolu urges politicians to shun violence, campaign on track records Ogun ADC gov candidate hails Supreme Court judgment, calls for unity 2027: SDP demands equal police protection for all parties “Andoni is yearning for a positive turn-around which only ADC can offer, this indeed is the reason the party has since been widely accepted across the 11 wards”. Speaking on behalf of the team, Gogo Wellington, chairman of the campaign council thanked the party for the opportunity to serve and promised to deliver victory for the party. “We will ensure a peaceful and productive exercise in Andoni even as we look forward to winning all elective seats for the ADC,” he said. Our correspondent reports that the campaign council also had Mbaba Charles (Vice Chairman), Golden Ekprikpo (Secretary), Zilpah Nehemiah (Director of Women) among others.
